response.sql: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) as avg_points, AVG(wins) as avg_wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points > 6.0 GROUP BY raceId), overall_avg_wins AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as overall_avg FROM race_averages WHERE avg_wins IS NOT NULL) SELECT ra.raceId, ra.avg_points, ra.avg_wins, CASE WHEN ra.avg_wins IS NOT NULL AND oaw.overall_avg IS NOT NULL THEN ra.avg_wins - oaw.overall_avg ELSE NULL END as wins_difference FROM race_averages ra CROSS JOIN overall_avg_wins oaw WHERE oaw.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN wins_difference IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, wins_difference DESC, ra.raceId LIMIT 10;
